overrides.reason: Generated from registry/repos.yaml: one row and one charter per repository, which is the contract agents read before creating or changing a repository. Splitting would separate a charter from the catalog. It shrinks as PDR-0002's merges and archives land; the next breach should be re-examined, not reflexively raised.

Append-only: entries are never deleted, so the register grows with each recorded conflict, and tools/check_platform.py resolves DRIFT IDs from this one file, so it cannot be split without changing the checker. Raised for DRIFT-017 (PDR-0053); the next breach should be re-examined, not reflexively raised.
